article.story: JONESBORO, Ark. -- — Jordan Pyke had 20 points in Arkansas State’s 100-69 win over UAPB on Wednesday. Pyke added five rebounds for the Red Wolves (3-2). Delang Muon added 15 points while shooting 6 of 6 from the field and 3 for 5 from the line while they also had 10 rebounds. Royal Blue Smith had 14 points and shot 4 for 8 (2 for 5 from 3-point range) and 4 of 6 from the free-throw line. Jalen Tatum finished with 21 points for the Golden Lions (0-6). UAPB also got 19 points from Jai’chaunn Hayes. Kalli Johnson finished with seven points. The loss was the Golden Lions’ sixth straight. Up next Arkansas State plays Monday against Southern Utah, and UAPB visits South Dakota on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
